title: Razorpay gets Sebi nod for Rs 5,000-6,000 crore IPO: sources
summary: Razorpay receives SEBI approval for an upcoming IPO of 5000 to 6000 crore rupees
detailed: ET reported on April 20 that Razorpay was preparing a confidential IPO filing to raise Rs 5,500-6,500 crore at an expected valuation of $5 billion (Rs 49,000-50,000 crore), below the $7.5 billion (around Rs 6,000 crore then) it commanded in its last major private funding round in 2021.
